attempt_review_none: After review you will see your score, without a breakdown
attempt_review_score_only: After review you will see the points for each question
attempt_review_full: After review you will see the points and the correct answers
attempt_rule_tab_switch: Leaving the tab is recorded as a violation
attempt_rule_copy_paste: Copying and pasting are blocked and recorded as violations
attempt_rule_right_click: The context menu is turned off
attempt_rule_fullscreen: Full screen is required: leaving it is recorded as a violation
attempt_reason_not_published: The quiz is not published yet
attempt_reason_remediation: First go through the mistakes of your last attempt
attempt_reason_access: This quiz is not assigned to you
attempt_reason_not_enrolled: Enroll in the course to take this quiz
attempt_time_up: Time is up: the attempt is being submitted
attempt_closed: Saving is closed: time is up or the deadline has passed. Answers are no longer accepted.
attempt_changed: The quiz has changed: review your answers and submit again
attempt_violations_exceeded: The violation limit is reached: the attempt will score zero when submitted
attempt_fullscreen_needed: The exam runs in full screen
attempt_submit_text: After submitting, the answers cannot be changed.
attempt_pending_text: Your submission is waiting for the teacher’s review.
attempt_awaiting_text: The grade will be published later.
attempt_returned_text: The submission was returned for revision.
attempt_auto_violation: The attempt scored zero because of violations.
